levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب
سعد بن عبد الله بن أبي خلف

notes: Two isnads carry the same saying («مِثْلَهُ»): the first runs to Abu Ja'far; the second («وَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي») is its own group.
The Imam named inside the chain after «عن» stays a narrator (owner ruling 2).
«بِإِسْنَادِهِ» refers to the isnad of Muhammad ibn Isma'il as written in the first route; it is kept as a back reference, not completed.
